svg.aria-label: Mechanism of the Reimer-Tiemann reaction through dichlorocarbene
svg.title: Mechanism of the Reimer-Tiemann reaction through dichlorocarbene

g.text: Step 1: base generates the electrophile, dichlorocarbene (:CCl₂)
Step 2: the phenoxide ion (ortho-carbanion resonance form) attacks the carbene
Steps 3–4: proton shift restores the aromatic ring; hydroxide then hydrolyses the CHCl₂ group; acidification gives the aldehyde
